lines.text: Many learners say: Can I have the receipt for this cake?
Better: Can I have the recipe for this cake?
Recipe is the word for cooking.
Recipe! Can I have the recipe for this cake?

data.wrong: Can I have the receipt for this cake?
data.right: Can I have the recipe for this cake?
data.why: Recipe is the word for cooking.

en.tip: A “receipt” is from a store. A cooking “Rezept” is a “recipe.”
en.caption: A cooking “Rezept” is a “recipe”! Wrong: “Can I have the receipt for this cake?” Right: “Can I have the recipe for this cake?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
